topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses microbial products and tissue damage through PAMPs, DAMPs, and diverse pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how activated sentinel cells orchestrate leukocyte recruitment and lymphatic drainage, as well as the risks of excessive systemic inflammation like septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory adaptations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms that turn off inflammation, repair damaged tissues, and manage persistent triggers through chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture and announces the subject of the upcoming lecture.
